notes.title: V1.1.0 Release Note
notes.content:
1- Added second and third light sources

Now, we can achieve more diverse and rich lighting effects with three independently controlled light sources. This upgrade not only increases the flexibility of lighting, but also provides more possibilities for creative lighting design. Whether in a home theater, art exhibition or stage performance, the combination of three light sources can bring unprecedented visual experience.

Features:
- Multi-light Source control : Each light source can be individually adjusted for brightness and color temperature to achieve precise light allocation.
- Dynamic effect : Supports the creation of dynamic light and shadow changes to add movement and vitality to the activity.

https://aurorabear2000.github.io/LuminaryPrimer/assets/image/en/V1_1_0/threefoldlight.jpg

2- Added light source direction indication

In order to display the illumination direction of each light source more intuitively, we specially added the light source direction indication function. By simple operation, the user can turn on or off this indicator switch, so that the actual path of each light source can be clearly seen.

Highlights:
- Visual display : Display the direction of the light source in a graphical way, easy to understand and operate.
- Real-time adjustment : Adjust the direction of the light source at any time as needed to ensure the best lighting effect.
- Teaching Aid : For beginners, this is a great tool to learn and understand lighting layout.

https://aurorabear2000.github.io/LuminaryPrimer/assets/image/en/V1_1_0/lightdirection.jpg

3- Light presets can be applied to second and third light sources

In addition to the basic single light source control, we also provide a combination of preset effects. This means that you can apply a variety of pre-set lighting modes to the second and third light sources, further enriching the scene's expressiveness.

Advantages:
- Fast switching : One click to call the preset combination, saving setup time.
- Unlimited creativity : Free to match different presets to inspire more creative inspiration.
- Consistency Guarantee : Ensure that the same visual effect is achieved every time you use it.

https://aurorabear2000.github.io/LuminaryPrimer/assets/image/en/V1_1_0/lightcombination.jpg

4- Help

To make it easier for users to get started and take advantage of these new features, we've added a dedicated "Help" button to the interface. After clicking this button, the system will automatically jump to the online manual page, which details the use of all the new features and related tips.

Convenience:
- Comprehensive Guide : Everything from the basics to advanced applications.
- Continuous update : As the software version is iterated, the online manual will be updated simultaneously.

https://aurorabear2000.github.io/LuminaryPrimer/assets/image/en/V1_1_0/help.jpg
